page.layout: One printed page, single text column; running head at top with page number at top right; two handwritten marginal annotations in the right margin (not printed, so not transcribed as notes).

main_text.p: ta terra admodum supereft ad posfi- dendum:
2 Hæc eft terra quę refidua eft, o- mnes limites Philisthinorū, & omnis Gefsuri.

3 A Nilo qui eft è regione AEgy- pti vsque ad terminū Hebron,qui est ab Aquilone, quæ Chananeę reputa- tur, quinque principatus Philisthino- rū, Azatheus, Asdodæus, Ascaloneus, Gitthæus, & Ekroneus, & Aueí.
4 Ab Austro vniuersa terra Cha- nanæi & Meara, quæ est Sidoniorum vsque ad Pæra, vsque ad terminum Emorrhæi.
5 Et terra Gibli, & totus Libanus ad Ortum solis à Baal-gad sub monte Hermon,donec peruenias Hemath.
6 Omnes habitatores montis à Li- bano vsque ad feruores aquarum: omnes Sidonios ego expellam à facie filiorum Israel:tantùm iacias sortem, vt sit in hęreditatem Israeli,sicut præ-

page.notes: Handwritten marginal annotations in the right margin ("Ecron", "Sidon") are manuscript additions, not printed text. Underlining under "Hebron" and "Sidonios ego" is manuscript. Some letters in the printed text are faint; "Aueí" may be "Aueï" and "Gefsuri" is read as printed.
